LanguageData.MM_Guardian.label: Guardian
LanguageData.MM_Guardian.description: A small construct for defense and shield support, using 1 bandwidth. It can attack with a continuous laser or restore shields on allied units and turrets, but cannot do both at once.\n\nAutomatic shield support is enabled by default. With automatic combat off, it only provides automatic support while drafted. It also hauls up to 40 kg, cleans and fights fires. It has a 75-point shield and consumes 20 light per game hour to recharge.
LanguageData.MM_Guardian.tools.0.label: support claws
LanguageData.MM_GuardianProjector.label: Guardian beam emitter
LanguageData.MM_GuardianProjector.description: The Guardian's built-in emitter provides continuous fire or restores allied shields. It cannot attack and restore shields at the same time.
